zh: 陈世龙打听到了刘不才的住处，一径就寻上门去，他跟嵇鹤龄一样，也是祖了一家式微世家的余屋住，不过另外开了个门，敲了两下，有个眉清目秀，但十分瘦的孩子来开门，转着乌黑的一双眼珠问道：“你找谁？”陈世龙听胡雪岩谈过，猜想他必是芙蓉的弟弟，随即说道：“小兔儿，你三叔呢？”“在里头。”等陈世龙要踏进去，他却堵着门不放，“你不要进来，先告诉我，你姓啥？”“怎么？”陈世龙答道，“你怕是我跟你三叔来讨债的？不是，不是！我姓陈，送钱来给你三叔的。“小兔儿有些将信将疑，但毕竟还是让步了。陈世龙一进门就觉得香味扑鼻，不由得咽了口唾沫，仔细辨一辨味道，是炖火腿的香味。“这家伙，真会享福！”一句话未完，看见刘不才的影子，哼着戏踱了出来，身上穿一件旧湖绪棉袄。下面是黑洋绉扎脚裤，两只裤脚扎得极其挺括，显得极有精神。
en: Chen Shilong found out where Liu Bucai lived and went straight there. Like Ji Heling, Liu had rented spare rooms in the house of an old family fallen on hard times, though his quarters had a separate entrance. After two knocks, a fine-featured but very thin boy opened the door. His dark eyes turned towards Chen. “Who are you looking for?” Remembering Hu Xueyan's account, Chen guessed that this must be Furong's brother. “Little Rabbit, where is your Third Uncle?” “Inside.” But when Chen tried to enter, the boy blocked the doorway. “Don't come in. Tell me your name first.” “Why? Are you afraid I've come to collect a debt from your uncle? No, no! My name is Chen. I've come to bring him money.” Little Rabbit remained doubtful, but at last let him through. At once a delicious aroma made Chen swallow. He recognised the scent of stewing ham. “The fellow certainly knows how to enjoy himself!” Before he had finished, Liu appeared, strolling out and humming an operatic tune. He wore an old padded jacket of Hu silk and black imported-crepe trousers, their ankles tied with such neat precision that he looked remarkably brisk.

zh: “小和尚！想不到是你。”“刘三爷！待为来跟你老人家请安。”过于谦恭，反成戏谑，刘不才便骂：“去你的，寻什么穷开心！”“不是这话。”陈世龙答道，“从前叫你刘不才，如今不同了，你变成我的长辈，规矩不能不讲。”“咦！”刘不才眨着眼说，“我倒没有想到，忽然爆出来的这么个晚辈！是怎么来的，你说来听听！““你跟我先生结成亲戚，不就是我的长辈？”刘不才愣了一下，换了副傲慢的神色：“我不晓得你的先生是哪个？反正我最近没有跟什么人结亲，谦称奉壁，蜗居也不足以容大驾，请！”说着将手向外一指，竟下了逐客令。陈世龙有些发窘，但当然不能翻脸，在平时，翻脸就翻脸，也无所谓，此刻是奉命差遣，不能不忍一忍，同时还得想办法让刘三才取消逐客令。
en: “Little Monk! I didn't expect you.” “Third Master Liu, I've come especially to pay my respects.” Excessive humility turned the greeting into mockery, and Liu retorted, “Away with you! Why make fun of a poor man?” “That isn't what I mean. I used to call you Liu Bucai. Now things are different. You've become my elder, and I must observe the proper forms.” “Well!” Liu blinked. “I never expected a younger relation to spring up so suddenly. Tell me, where have you come from?” “You've become related to my teacher. Doesn't that make you my elder?” Liu paused, then assumed an arrogant expression. “I don't know who your teacher is. In any case, I haven't recently formed a marriage connection with anyone. I return the honour you offer. My humble dwelling cannot accommodate your distinguished presence. This way, please!” Pointing outside, he ordered his guest to leave. Chen felt embarrassed, but could hardly quarrel. Ordinarily he might have done so without concern. Today he had been sent on a mission. He must endure it and find some way to make Liu Sancai withdraw the dismissal.

zh: 于是他尽量装出自然的笑容，“刘三爷，你真不够朋友，炖着那么好吃的东西，一个人享用，好意思？莫非，”他说，“你不想在赌场里见面了？”提到赌场，刘三才的气焰一挫。彼此的交情虽不深，但输了就顾不到体面、曾有两三次向陈世龙伸手借过赌本，想起这点情分，也是话柄，他的脸板不成了。“要怪你自己不知趣！‘哪壶水不开，偏提哪一壶’，你晓得我讨厌我那个侄女儿，你偏要拿她来触我的心境，叫人光火不光火？”“好了，好了，说过算数。如果你留我吃饭，你出菜，我出酒。小兔儿，你来！”陈世龙摸出块五六钱的碎银子问道：“你会不会上街买东西？”“你要买什么？”刘不才问。“巷口那家酒店的‘绍烧，我吃过，不坏，叫他们送两斤来，把酒钱带去给他。”说着，他把银子塞到小兔儿子里，“多下的送你买梨膏糖吃！”“没有要你破费的道理！”刘不才赶上来插在他跟小兔儿中间，一只手到他侄儿手里去夺银子，一只手又推陈世龙，仿佛不让他给钱似地。这就象下馆子抢着惠帐，只拉住了别人的不管用的左手一样，完全是“障眼法”。结果是那块碎银子到了刘不才手里，却叫小兔儿到酒店里去赊帐。从这个行为上，陈世龙看透了他；骨头硬不到哪里去！他跟芙蓉也决不会决裂。
en: He forced the most natural smile he could. “Third Master Liu, you're no friend! Stewing something so delicious and keeping it all to yourself—aren't you ashamed? Or don't you expect to meet me at the gambling table again?” Mention of gambling weakened Liu's defiance. They were not close friends, but after losing, he had forgotten his dignity and borrowed gambling money from Chen two or three times. Remembering the obligation—and the hold it gave Chen—he could no longer maintain his stern face. “Blame your own tactlessness! You always pick up the kettle that won't boil. You know I can't stand that niece of mine, yet you bring her up to provoke me. How could I help being angry?” “Very well. Let that be the end of it. If you'll keep me to dinner, you provide the food and I'll provide the drink. Little Rabbit, come here!” Chen took out a scrap of silver weighing five or six qian. “Can you go shopping?” “What do you want to buy?” Liu asked. “I've tried the Shaoxing spirit at the shop by the lane entrance. It's good. Ask them to send two jin and take the money.” He put the silver into the boy's hand. “Keep the change for pear-syrup sweets!” “There's no reason for you to spend money!” Liu hurried between them, reaching with one hand for the silver and pushing Chen with the other, as though preventing payment. It was pure sleight of hand, like pretending to fight over a restaurant bill while holding only the other man's unoccupied left hand. The silver ended up in Liu's possession, while Little Rabbit was sent to obtain the liquor on credit. Chen saw through him. His backbone was not so stiff after all! He would never truly break with Furong either.

zh: “来，来！”刘不才的兴致又很好了，把沙锅盖一揭，鼻子闻了两下，得意的笑道：“ ‘走得着，谢双脚’，你的口福不坏！陈火腿全靠收拾得干净，整整搞了一上午，才把上面的毛钳干净。”“刘三爷！”陈世龙趁机说道，“你的陈火腿吃不光！我今天来拉拢一桩生意。”“生意？”刘不才不信他，“怎么找到我头上？跟我有啥生意好谈？”自然有！等下我再告诉你。“等酒杯一端上手，陈世龙才道明来意，他说他有个朋友，预备在杭州开一家极大的药店，知道“刘敬德堂”的名气，也知道刘不才是行家，特地托他来探问一下，想邀刘不才合伙。“合伙？怎么合法？”刘不才摇着头说，“别的事都好谈，这件事谈不拢，我哪里有股本？”“你不是有几张祖传的药方子？”这话一说出口，刘不才的脸色顿时就很难看了，笑容尽敛，冷冷笑道：“原来是打我这个主意！怪道，我说世界上还有这样子的好人，不嫌我穷，来邀我台伙！”
en: “Come along!” Liu's spirits had recovered. Lifting the earthenware pot's lid, he sniffed twice and smiled proudly. “‘Thank your feet for bringing you here.’ You're fortunate in your food! With aged ham, everything depends on cleaning it properly. I've spent the whole morning plucking every hair from it.” “Third Master Liu,” Chen seized the opening, “you'll have more aged ham than you can eat. I've come to bring you a business opportunity.” “Business?” Liu was unconvinced. “Why come to me? What business could we discuss?” “There is some. I'll tell you shortly.” Only when they had their cups in hand did Chen explain. A friend intended to open a very large medicine shop in Hangzhou. Knowing Liu Jingde Hall's reputation and Liu's expertise, he had asked Chen to inquire whether Liu would become his partner. “A partner? On what terms?” Liu shook his head. “We can discuss anything else, but this won't work. Where would I find capital?” “Haven't you several medicinal formulas handed down in your family?” Liu's expression darkened immediately. His smile vanished. “So that's what you're after! No wonder! I thought it strange that someone should be kind enough to overlook my poverty and invite me into partnership.”

zh: 话和神色，都让陈世龙忍不住心头火发，“咦！”他也很不客气地回敬：“怪道叫你刘不才！‘狗咬吕侗宾，不识好人心’，怎见得人家打你那几张药方的主意？你晓得人家是怎么说？”“且慢！”刘不才的态度变得受商量了，“我先问一声，想跟我合伙的是哪一个？是不是姓胡的？”陈世龙很机警，趁机反问一句：“你见过我那位胡先生没有？”“从来不曾见过。”“那我告诉你，”陈世龙既不说破，也不否认，“此人是个候补知县，在官场中很红，本人虽不出面，却有好些差使跟他有关系。他要开药店也不光是为了做生意，是存心济世……”“好了，好了！”刘不才不屑地，“ ‘修合虽无人见，存心自有天知’，药店里挂的这副对子，是啥花样，难道我还不知道？何必到我面前来卖这种膏药？”“不是我在你面前卖膏药，人家这么告诉我，我照本宣科，信不信在你！”“闲话少说，他做生意也好，存心济世也好，与我无关。如说要邀我合伙，看中我那几张祖传秘方，请他趁早少打主意。”“你为来为去是怕方子落在人家手里，你要晓得，人家并不要你的什么宝贝方子！”“那……”刘不才愕然，不知这话从何说起了。
en: His words and manner angered Chen. “Well!” he replied just as sharply. “No wonder people call you Liu Bucai! Like the dog that bit Lü Dongbin, you don't recognise kindness. What makes you think he wants to steal your formulas? Do you know what he actually proposes?” “Wait.” Liu became more amenable. “First, who is this would-be partner? Is his surname Hu?” Chen promptly turned the question back on him. “Have you ever met my Mr Hu?” “Never.” “Then let me tell you.” Chen neither confirmed nor denied the identity. “This man is an expectant county magistrate, very well regarded in official circles. Though he doesn't appear in person, he is connected with many public appointments. He wants a medicine shop for more than trade. His intention is to help the world...” “Enough!” Liu said scornfully. “‘Though none see the compounding, Heaven knows the heart.’ Do you think I don't understand that couplet hanging in medicine shops? Why try to sell me that remedy?” “I'm not selling you anything. I'm merely repeating what I was told. Believe it or not, as you please.” “Spare me the talk. Whether he wants profit or to help the world is nothing to me. If the partnership means getting hold of my family's secret formulas, tell him to abandon the idea.” “It all comes down to your fear of the formulas falling into someone else's hands. You should know that he doesn't want possession of your precious recipes!” “Then...” Liu was astonished and could not understand.

zh: 于是陈世龙转述了合伙的办法，刘不才的祖传秘方，当然要用，可是不要求他把方子公开，将来开了药店，清他以股东的身分在店里坐镇，这几张方子上的药，请他自己修合。“君臣佐使”是哪几味药？分量多少？如何炮制？只有他自己知道，何虑秘方泄漏？原来人家不是来图谋自己的秘方，刘不才倒觉得刚才的态度，未免鲁莽，因而歉意地点点头：“这倒还可以谈谈！”“我再告诉你，人家提出来的条件，合情合理，药归你去台，价钱由人家来定，你抽成头。你的药灵，销得好，你的成头就多，你的药不灵，没人要，那就对不起，请你带了你的宝贝方子卷铺盖！”“药怎么会不灵？尤其是一种‘狗皮膏药，明朝的一个皇帝，靠了它才生的太子，真正是无价之宝！”“吹什么牛！”陈世龙笑道：“刘敬德堂的狗皮膏药，哪个不晓得，完全是骗人的东西！”“这你就不懂了！老实告诉你，方于是真的，药太贵重，而合起来交关麻烦，只好马马虎虎，效验当然就差了。这且不去说它！”刘不才把腰挺一挺，双手靠在桌上，凑近陈世龙，显得相当认真地说：“这位老朋友说的话很上路，看起来决不是半吊子。他的办法在我有益无损，可进可退，只要成头谈得拢，我就跟他合伙。”
en: Chen explained the arrangement. Naturally the inherited formulas would be used, but Liu would not have to disclose them. Once the shop opened, he would work there as a partner and compound those medicines himself. Which ingredients served as sovereign, minister, assistant, and envoy, their quantities, and the methods of preparation would be known to him alone. Why fear the secrets leaking out? Realising that nobody meant to take his formulas, Liu felt he had been rash. He nodded apologetically. “That is something we could discuss.” “And the terms are reasonable. You compound the medicines; he sets the prices; you receive a percentage. If your medicines work and sell well, your share increases. If they don't work and nobody wants them, then, I'm sorry, you take your precious formulas and pack your bags.” “How could they fail to work? There's one dogskin plaster that enabled a Ming emperor to father a crown prince. It's priceless!” “What boasting!” Chen laughed. “Everyone knows Liu Jingde Hall's dogskin plaster. It's a complete fraud!” “You don't understand. Honestly, the formula is genuine, but the ingredients are terribly costly and the preparation very troublesome. We had to cut corners, so naturally its effects were poorer. Never mind that now.” Liu straightened, braced his hands on the table, and leaned earnestly towards Chen. “Your friend speaks like someone who knows his way about. He's no fool. His proposal benefits me without harming me. I can go forward or withdraw. If we agree on my percentage, I'll join him.”

zh: “那么你说，你想怎么抽法？”“我先要问一句，价钱为啥要归他定？应该大家商量商量。”“这没有商量的余地，因为你想定得高，人家既然为了济世，自然要定得低。”陈世龙觉得这话说得不好，便又补了一句：“再说，薄利多卖，生意才会好，竹杠把人家敲怕了，不上你的门，药再好也无用。”“这话也对。不过既然薄利，我的成头要多抽些。”陈世龙也很精明，“既然是薄利多卖，你名下的也不会少，怎么说要多抽？”接着他又自下转语，“不过，这都好商量，等你们碰了头，当面再谈，一定会谈得很投机。”刘不才点点头，用手抓着一块火腿脚爪在嘴里啃，同时一双眼珠骨碌碌地转着，见得他在心里有极周详的盘算，陈世龙也不催他答话，只是冷眼旁观，看他的神态，打自己的主意。“就这样了！”刘不才把火腿骨头一丢，使劲擦着手说：“我决定交这个人！小和尚，你说，哪天跟他碰头？事情既然决定了，就不必耽搁，越快越好！”
en: “Then tell me what share you want.” “First, why should he set the prices? We ought to discuss them together.” “There's no room for discussion there. You would want them high. Since he wants to help people, he'll naturally keep them low.” Feeling that this was not well put, Chen added, “Besides, small profits and large sales make good business. If you frighten customers away by overcharging, even the best medicine is useless.” “That's true. But if profits are small, my percentage should be higher.” Chen was shrewd too. “With small profits and large sales, your total won't be small either. Why should the percentage increase?” Then he softened his position. “Still, all that can be discussed. Settle it face to face when you meet. I'm sure you'll get on very well.” Liu nodded. Gnawing a piece of ham trotter held in his hand, he rolled his eyes about in a way that showed how carefully he was calculating. Chen did not press him, merely watched coolly and considered his own next move. “That's settled!” Liu threw down the bone and wiped his hands vigorously. “I've decided to make this man's acquaintance. Little Monk, when shall we meet? Once a thing is decided, there's no point delaying. The sooner the better!”

zh: 看他心思如此活动，陈世龙便进一步逗引他：“刘三爷！你还有什么话，自己不便说，我可以替你转达。你们没有见面前，你有什么难处，我可以替你想办法，等你们见了面，有话自己谈，就没有我的事了。”刘不才原就想开口，听陈世龙这一说，恰中下怀，当即定一定神答道：“小和尚，承你的好意，我也不必瞒你，我的境况，你是晓得的，他要请我到杭州去跟他合伙，谈妥当了，也要我动得成身才行！”“我晓得。”陈世尤问道：“你身上有多少债务？”“也不过几百两银子。”“嗯！”陈世龙又问，“你的傈儿呢？要托人照应啊！”“不必！我带到杭州去。”“喔！”陈世龙站起身来说，“那么，我先去告诉人家，什么时候碰头，我明天一早来给你回音。”
en: Seeing his eagerness, Chen encouraged him further. “Third Master Liu, is there anything you find awkward to say? I can pass it on. Before you meet, I can help with any difficulties. Afterwards you'll talk directly, and it will no longer be my affair.” Liu had wanted just such an opening. Collecting himself, he said, “Little Monk, since you're kind enough, I needn't conceal anything. You know my circumstances. If he wants me to join him in Hangzhou, even after we agree, I must be able to leave.” “I understand. How much debt do you have?” “Only a few hundred taels.” “And your nephew? Someone must look after him.” “No need. I'll take him to Hangzhou.” “I see.” Chen stood. “Then I'll report to him first. I'll bring word early tomorrow about when you can meet.”

zh: 一夜过去，刘不才起来得特别早。他家里不象样，“出客”的衣服，依旧很漂亮，不但料子，连花样都有讲究，一件铁灰摹本缎的袍子，松竹梅的暗花，梅花还只含苞初放，因为这是早晨，倘或下午穿出去，还有一件，那梅花就开得极盛了。打扮好了，在家坐等陈世龙的回音。到了九点钟只听有人敲门，刘不才亲自去开门一看，不由得愣住了，门外两顶轿子四个人，一个老妈子，一个丫头，一个是极艳丽的少妇，还有一个是自己的侄女儿！“三叔！”穿着红裙的芙容，叫了一声，不等他应声，便回身为那少妇引见：“这位是郁太太，这是我三叔！”郁太太自然是阿七，当时盈盈含笑地喊道：“刘三爷！”刘不才有些发急。他好面子，而家里乱六八糟，如何好意思接待这位珠翠满头、艳光照人的郁太太？一时有些手足无措，拚命在想，怎么样得能挡驾，不让她们进门？而就在这时候，从他胁下钻出来一个人，是小兔儿！
en: Next morning Liu rose unusually early. His home might be shabby, but his visiting clothes remained splendid. Not only their material but even their patterns were carefully chosen. His iron-grey robe of moben satin had a subtle design of pine, bamboo, and plum. The plum blossoms were only just opening, appropriate to the morning. For an afternoon outing, he had another robe on which they were in full bloom. Dressed, he sat waiting for Chen's message. At nine, someone knocked. Opening the door himself, he was astonished to find two sedan chairs and four people: an older woman servant, a maid, an exceptionally beautiful young woman, and his own niece. “Third Uncle!” Furong, wearing a red skirt, called to him. Without waiting for his reply, she turned to introduce her companion. “This is Mrs Yu. This is my Third Uncle.” Mrs Yu was naturally A’qi. With a graceful smile, she greeted him. “Third Master Liu!” He grew anxious. He cared about appearances, and his home was in chaos. How could he receive this radiant Mrs Yu, her hair resplendent with jewels? Flustered, he desperately sought some way to keep them from entering. Just then, Little Rabbit slipped beneath his arm.

zh: “姐姐！”“小免儿！”芙蓉一把将她兄弟揽在怀里，接着便捧着他的脸端详了一下，痛心地埋怨：“看你，脏得这个样子！两个鼻孔象烟囱，只怕三天没有洗过脸了！”一面说，一面扯下衣纽上的绣花手帕，毫无顾惜地为小兔儿去擦鼻子。“刘三爷！冒昧得很，我送我这个妹妹来见叔太爷，请到里面坐了，好行礼！”这一下反客为主，刘不才枪法大乱，而芙蓉已经搀着小兔儿走了进去。到此地步，刘不才已经毫无主张，芙蓉的一切，暂时也无从去考虑，觉得眼前的唯一大事，是要打点精神来应酬这位艳丽的郁太太。于是他赔笑说道：“劳动郁太太，真正过意不去。请里面坐！地方又小又脏，实在委屈了贵客。”“不必客气！”阿七嫣然一笑，索性改了称呼：“刘三叔，都是自己人，用不着叙什么客套。”“是，是！郁太太说得是。请，我来领路。”
en: “Sister!” “Little Rabbit!” Furong caught her brother in her arms, then held his face to inspect it. “Look how dirty you are! Your nostrils are like chimneys. I don't suppose you've washed your face for three days!” Distressed, she pulled the embroidered handkerchief from her button and wiped his nose without a thought for the cloth. “Third Master Liu, forgive the intrusion,” A’qi said. “I've brought my younger sister to pay respects to her uncle. Please sit inside so that she can make her bow.” Suddenly the visitor had taken command. Liu lost his bearings, while Furong had already led Little Rabbit indoors. Now he had no course of his own. Whatever concerned Furong must wait. His sole immediate task was to receive the beautiful Mrs Yu properly. Smiling apologetically, he said, “I'm terribly sorry to trouble you. Please come in. Such a small, dirty place is unworthy of distinguished guests.” “No formalities!” A’qi smiled and changed her form of address. “Third Uncle Liu, we're all family. There's no need for ceremony.” “Yes, yes! Quite right, Mrs Yu. This way. I'll show you in.”

zh: 刘不才甩着衣袖，走几步路着实潇洒，进了他那间起坐兼饭厅的客堂，亲自端了他的唯一象样的一样家具，那张红木的骨牌凳，抽出雪白的手绢，拂了两下，请阿七落座。接着又找茶叶、洗茶碗，口中还要跟客人寒暄，一个人唱独脚戏似地在那里忙个不停，仿佛忘掉了还有个芙蓉在。芙蓉跟阿七对看了一眼，都觉得有点好笑，同时也都感到安慰，因为看样子，刘不才是很好说话的了。“刘三叔！你不必费心！请坐下来，我有几句正经话说。”“好！恭敬不如从命。郁太太有什么吩咐？”刘不才等坐了下来才发觉，小兔儿不但脸洗得极干净，而且已换上了一件新罩袍，安安静静偎倚着他姐姐坐着。“刘三叔，”阿七问道，“你前天怎么不来吃喜酒？”这第一句话就问得刘不才发窘，只能故意装作讶异地问：“喜酒？”
en: With a graceful swing of his sleeves, Liu led them into the room that served as both sitting room and dining room. He fetched his only respectable piece of furniture, a rectangular rosewood stool, and dusted it with his spotless handkerchief before inviting A’qi to sit. Then he searched for tea, washed cups, and kept up polite conversation, bustling about like a performer in a one-man show. He seemed to have forgotten Furong entirely. The two women exchanged a glance, amused and reassured. He now appeared quite easy to deal with. “Third Uncle Liu, don't trouble yourself. Sit down. I have something serious to say.” “Very well. Obedience is better than ceremony. What are your instructions?” Only after sitting did he notice that Little Rabbit's face was perfectly clean and that he wore a new outer robe, sitting quietly against his sister. “Why didn't you come to the wedding feast the day before yesterday?” A’qi's first question embarrassed him. He could only pretend surprise. “Wedding feast?”

zh: “是啊，我芙蓉妹子的喜酒。”阿七紧接着把话挑明，“刘三叔，你心里一定有误会。你看看，芙蓉穿的啥裙子？那位胡老爷是三房合一子，照规矩可以娶三房家小，芙蓉是他的‘湖州太太’，跟他的‘杭州太太’又不见面。人家抬举芙蓉，你这个做亲叔叔的，先把侄女儿贬得不是人！好日子都不到，叫人家看起来，真当我们芙蓉妹子，是怎么样的低三下四。你想想看，哪有这个道理？“阿七的言词爽利，表情又来得丰富，斜睨正视，眼风如电，这番兴师问罪的话，把刘不才说得服服帖帖，赔笑答道：“郁太太说得是！是我不对。”接着又转脸看着芙蓉说：“我哪里知道，是这么回事？早知如此，我自然出面替你办喜事。现在只有这样，我发帖子，请大家补吃喜酒。”“这是一桩！”阿七紧接着他的话说，“还有一桩，刘三叔！刘三婶过去了，你也不续弦，孤家寡人一个，带着侄儿也不方便。不如让芙蓉把她兄弟领了去！”“这一层……”刘不才终于答应了：“也好！”阿七很高兴地笑了，“多谢刘三叔！”她说，“总算给我面子。不过，还有件事，我要请问，你们什么时候会亲？”这是指的跟胡雪岩见面，刘不才心想，当然是侄女婿先来拜叔岳。不过家里实在不象样，最好晚几天，等把药店合伙的事情谈好，先弄几文钱到手，略略铺排一下，面子比较好看。于是他说：“这要挑个好日子。我也要预备预备，能不能稍停两天再说？”
en: “Yes, Furong's wedding feast.” A’qi made her meaning plain. “Third Uncle Liu, there must be some misunderstanding. Look at the skirt she's wearing! Mr Hu is the sole son carrying on three family branches. By custom, he may take a wife for each branch. Furong is his Huzhou wife and won't even meet his Hangzhou wife. Others honour her, yet her own uncle treats her as though she were worthless! You stayed away even on her happy day, making people think she was some low creature. Tell me, how can that be right?” Her words were brisk and her expression vivid; whether glancing sideways or directly at him, her eyes flashed. The accusation brought Liu entirely to submission. Smiling apologetically, he said, “You're right, Mrs Yu. I was wrong.” Turning to Furong, he added, “How was I to know? If I'd understood, I'd naturally have arranged your wedding myself. There's only one thing now: I'll send invitations and give a belated feast.” “That's one matter,” A’qi continued. “Here's another. Your wife has died, and you haven't remarried. Living alone and caring for a nephew is inconvenient. Why not let Furong take her brother?” “As for that...” At last Liu agreed. “Very well.” A’qi smiled delightedly. “Thank you, Third Uncle Liu. You've done me an honour. One more thing: when will the families meet?” This meant meeting Hu. Naturally, Liu thought, his niece's husband should first call on his uncle by marriage. But the house was dreadful. Better to wait until the medicine-shop partnership was settled and he had a little money to improve appearances. “We must choose an auspicious day. I need to make preparations. Could we wait a day or two?”

zh: 阿六也是受命试探，重要的不在哪一天，是刘不才对胡雪岩的态度。芙蓉是他的亲人，不论怎么样，他不能不理，但对胡雪岩不同，说不定发了“大爷脾气”，不愿认亲，甚至表面同意，见了面说几句不中听的话，以胡雪岩此时的身分，丢不起这个面子。因此，他派出两路人马试探，一路是陈世尤，只谈生意。一路就是阿七，先抬高芙蓉的身分，消除刘不才的愤懑疑忌，然后再提会亲的话，看他是何态度？阿七也是久经沧桑，饱阅世态的人，看刘不才这样回答，便知对胡雪岩已不存丝毫敌意。所谓“预备预备”，多半也是实话。事情到此，自己可以交差，现在该想办法让他们叔侄有个谈谈体己的机会。这也容易，她顺手拉过小兔儿来问了几句“今年几岁”、“可曾上蒙馆读书”之类的话，随后很自然地牵着他到廊下，去看他叔叔所养的那几笼鸟。这一来刘不才自然要说话了，“芙蓉”，他问，“那姓胡的。到底怎么样？”“你见了就知道了。”这是很满意的表示，刘不才凝神想了一下，发觉自己已不象前两天那样，无缘无故心里就来气，再细想一想，芙蓉以再嫁之身，而且命中注定该做偏房，结果成了“两头大”，也算是差强人意，同时又想到陈世龙来谈的合伙开药店的那件事，内心更是充满了兴奋，觉得时来运转，翻身的日子快到了。
en: A’qi too had been sent to sound him out. The important point was his attitude towards Hu, not the date. Furong was his own relation; whatever happened, he could hardly ignore her. Hu was another matter. Liu might put on grand airs and refuse the connection, or agree publicly and then say something offensive at their meeting. In Hu's present position, he could not afford that humiliation. He had therefore sent out two separate parties: Chen to discuss business alone, and A’qi to elevate Furong's status, dispel Liu's resentment and suspicion, and then test his response to a family meeting. A’qi had seen enough of the world to recognise that no hostility towards Hu remained. His wish to prepare was probably genuine. Her mission was accomplished. Now she should give uncle and niece a chance to speak privately. That was easy. Drawing Little Rabbit over, she asked his age and whether he had begun lessons, then naturally led him onto the veranda to see his uncle's caged birds. Left alone, Liu asked, “Furong, what is this man Hu really like?” “You'll know when you meet him.” The answer showed her satisfaction. Liu reflected that he no longer felt the causeless anger of the previous two days. A remarrying widow, supposedly destined to be a concubine, had instead become one of two wives with equal standing in separate households. That was tolerable. And the medicine-shop partnership filled him with excitement. His luck was turning; recovery seemed near.

zh: “这样子总算马马虎虎过得去！如果你真的替人做小，叫我走出去怎么见入？当然，这也怪我叔叔没出息！且不去说它了。芙蓉，我告诉你一个好消息，有人请我台伙开药店。”接着，他把陈世龙所谈的一切，都告诉她。芙蓉很有耐心地听着。她这时才完全了解胡雪岩的用心，怪不得都说他能干！想出来的办法，实在叫人佩服。然而，欣慰之外，也不免忧虑，当时就把心事说了出来。“三叔！事情是好事情，就怕你拆烂污。”“你总是这个样！”刘不才不悦，“处处不相信我。”“不是不相信你三叔，你不晓得我心里着急！四十多的人了，一天到晚做‘马浪荡’，怎么得了？难得有这样一个机会，你如果再拆烂污拆得人家见了你就躲，你倒想想看，哪里再还有翻身的日子？”“哼，你不懂！”刘不才依然不服帖，“我只管照方合药。既不经手银钱，又不管店堂里的事，每个月坐分成头，有啥烂污好拆？”“不一定银钱上拆烂污，有了钱成夭在赌场里，误了正事，也是拆烂污。”
en: “This is passable, after all. If you'd really become someone's concubine, how could I face people? Of course, that's partly because your uncle has amounted to nothing. Never mind that now. Furong, I have good news. Someone has asked me to join him in opening a medicine shop.” He told her everything Chen had proposed. She listened patiently. Only now did she fully understand Hu's intentions. No wonder everyone called him capable! His method was admirable. Yet her pleasure was mixed with worry, which she expressed at once. “Third Uncle, it's a good thing. I'm only afraid you'll make a mess of it.” “You're always like this!” Liu was displeased. “You never trust me.” “It's not that I don't trust you. You don't understand how anxious I am! You're over forty and still drift about all day. How can that continue? Such a chance is rare. If you ruin it until people avoid you whenever they see you, where will you find another chance to recover?” “Hmph! You don't understand.” He remained unconvinced. “I'll only compound medicines according to the formulas. I won't handle money or run the shop. I'll receive my share every month. What mess could I make?” “It needn't be a matter of mishandling money. Spending your days gambling and neglecting your duties would make a mess of things too.”

zh: 芙蓉紧接着又说，“ 还有一层，人家倒看得三叔你有本事，要请你做档手，那时候你怎么样呢？”这一问是刘不才所不曾想到的，细想一想确是个疑问。“你看，是不是？”芙蓉趁势逼他发愤，“三叔，你连自己都没有把握，怎么还怪我不相信你？”“事情好办。人家要请我做档手，我不做。这样子没有烂污好拆，你总该放心了吧！”“懒和尚只求没布施！ ”芙蓉有些气，“没有看见过你这样的人，你只会说大话！”“我何尝说过什么大话？”刘不才越发不高兴，“你在那里乱扯！”“那么我倒要问，说敬德堂从你手里败掉的，还要从你手里恢复！可有这话？”“对，有的！这也不算说大话。”“还不是？”芙蓉逼视着问，“你拿什么来恢复？要说恢复，眼前的希望就在这等路子上，全要靠你自己去巴结，一方面省吃俭用，积少成多，有一份小小的资本，一方面安分守己帮人家把店开好了，可以开口请人家帮忙。这样子两下一凑，刘敬德堂的招牌才有重新挂出来的一天。照你现在的想法，有多少用多少，只图眼前快活，哪里有什么长远的打算。请问三叔，你不是在说大话？“长篇大套地一顿驳，把做叔叔的说得哑口无言，但仔细想去，却不能不说她看得透彻，想得周到。商场中妄想由伙计变作大老板，这样做生意最稳当不过。但是，他还是开不得口，因为自己估量自己，实在没有把握能够做到芙蓉所说的“省吃俭用、安分守己”八个字。
en: “And another thing,” Furong continued. “Suppose they recognise your ability and ask you to be the manager. What then?” This had not occurred to Liu. On reflection, it was a real question. “You see?” She pressed him to exert himself. “You don't even trust yourself. Why blame me for not trusting you?” “Simple. If they ask me to manage, I'll refuse. Then there'll be no mess to make. Surely you can be easy now?” “A lazy monk hopes for no offerings!” Furong was annoyed. “I've never seen anyone like you. All you do is boast!” “When have I boasted?” He became angrier. “You're talking nonsense.” “Then let me ask: didn't you say that, since Jingde Hall had failed in your hands, you would restore it yourself?” “Yes, I did. That's no boast.” “Isn't it?” She looked directly at him. “What will you restore it with? Your hope now lies in just such an opportunity, and everything depends on your effort. On one side, live frugally and save little by little until you have some capital. On the other, behave responsibly and help them establish the shop, so that you can ask for their support. Together, those things might put Liu Jingde Hall's signboard up again. As you think now, spending everything you have for present pleasure, what plans have you made for the future? Tell me, Third Uncle, isn't that boasting?” Her sustained argument left him speechless. Thinking it over, he had to admit how clearly she saw and how carefully she had planned. For a clerk aspiring to become a proprietor, no path could be sounder. Yet he still could not answer. Judging himself honestly, he had no confidence that he could live frugally and behave responsibly as she demanded.

zh: 就这沉默之际，只见进来一个脚步匆匆的年轻人，刘不才赶到门口细看，才认出是陈世龙，便喊一声：“小和尚！”心里奇怪，他跟这位郁太太怎么也相熟？因为两人面对面在低声细语，不熟不会这样子谈话。陈世尤答应着走了过来，看见芙蓉，恭恭敬敬叫了一声：“师母！”然后才转脸向刘不才说：“刘三爷，我已经约好了，有空就走！”“好，好，就走。”刘不才向她侄女儿说，“就是谈合伙的那一位。”于是芙蓉带着小兔儿，和阿七上轿而去。刘不才请陈世龙坐下来，先要了解一下情况，到底对方是准？在哪里见面？“就在郁太太他们聚成钱庄……”“慢来！”刘不才打断他的话问，“那位郁太太就是郁四的太太？”“是啊！”陈世龙说，“你不认识？”“我不认识，我也没有想到。只听说郁四有个小太太，前些日子吵散了，所以竟会想到郁太太就是郁四的小的。”说到这里，灵机一动，急急又问：“照这样子说，谈合伙的一定是胡雪岩？”事到如今，不必再满，陈世龙点点头答道：“不错！就是胡先生。你们至亲合伙，还有啥话说？刘三爷，一个人不怕下发达，不交运，就怕机会来了错过。机会来了看不到，犹有可说，明明看到，自己错过，将来噢悔的时候，那味道最不好受。”
en: During the silence, a young man hurried in. Liu went to the doorway and recognised Chen. “Little Monk!” He wondered how Chen knew Mrs Yu too: they were facing each other, speaking in low voices, as only acquaintances would. Chen answered and came over. Seeing Furong, he respectfully greeted his teacher's wife. “Madam!” Then he turned to Liu. “Third Master Liu, I've arranged the meeting. We can leave whenever you're ready.” “Yes, let's go.” Liu told his niece, “It's the man who proposed the partnership.” Furong took Little Rabbit, and she and A’qi departed in their chairs. Liu invited Chen to sit, wanting first to understand who the other man was and where they would meet. “At Jucheng Bank, Mrs Yu's...” “Wait!” Liu interrupted. “That Mrs Yu is Yu Si's wife?” “Yes. Didn't you know her?” “No, and it never occurred to me. I'd only heard that Yu's concubine had parted from him after a quarrel some time ago. I never imagined she was the Mrs Yu here.” An idea struck him. “Then the proposed partner must be Hu Xueyan?” There was no need to conceal it now. Chen nodded. “Exactly. Mr Hu. A partnership between close relations—what could be better? A man needn't fear lack of success or luck, Third Master Liu. He should fear missing an opportunity. Failure to recognise one may be excusable. Seeing it clearly and letting it pass brings the bitterest regret.”

zh: 刘不才不向，他觉得这件事多少要想一想，因为来得太突兀了。“赌钱讲究冷、准、狠！”陈世龙说：“现在是个‘大活门’，你不扑上去，就真正是刘不才！永世不得翻身。”“真的是‘大活门’？”“当然，只拿郁四叔来说好了！”陈世龙就由郁四谈到尤五，王有龄谈到嵇鹤岭，再由老张谈到他自己，结论是谁跟胡雪岩交往，谁就交运！一半事实，一半是陈世龙口舌玲珑的渲染，把刘不才听得全神贯注，一字不漏。“好！”他断然决然地，真有“赌场烈士”那种背城借一的壮烈之概，“我听你的劝告，就赌这一记了！”
en: Liu remained silent. It had come so suddenly that he needed to think. “Gambling requires coolness, accuracy, and daring,” Chen said. “Here's a splendid opening. If you don't seize it, you'll truly deserve the name Liu Bucai and never recover.” “Is it really such an opening?” “Of course. Take Uncle Four alone!” From Yu, Chen went on to You Laowu, from Wang Youling to Ji Heling, then from Old Zhang to himself. His conclusion was that everyone who associated with Hu found good fortune. Half fact and half skilful embellishment, the account held Liu's complete attention. He missed not a word. “Very well!” Liu declared with the heroic air of a gambler staking everything in a final battle. “I'll take your advice. I'll make this wager!”

zh: 陈世龙慢慢喝着茶解渴，同时在盘算下一着棋，他叫胡雪岩作“先生”，的确已从“先生”那里学到了许多驾驭的权术，刘不才此时正在心热，变卦是决不会的了，现在所要考虑的是，如何一下子叫他死心塌地，服服帖帖？“怎么样？”刘不才觉得他的沉默不可解，催问着。“讲得我口干舌燥，你也得让我先润润嗓子。”陈世龙放下茶杯，站起身来，“这佯，我先走，把你的难处去安排好，你中午自己到聚成来。怎么样？”“ 你是说，先给我去弄钱？”刘不才接下来说，“现在也无所谓了。”“这用不到客气！客气自己受罪。说句实话，你现在的境况也不怎么好，怕要请桌客都为难。到那时候，一面要办事，一面又要凑钱应付债主，反而原形毕露，面子失光，倒还不如我替你预先安排好的为妙。”想想也不错，刘不才便随他去。答允准定中午到聚成钱庄跟胡雪岩碰头。
en: Chen slowly drank his tea to ease his thirst while considering the next move. Calling Hu his teacher was no empty form: he had learned much about managing people. Liu was enthusiastic now and would not change his mind. The question was how to win his wholehearted loyalty at once. “Well?” Liu could not understand his silence. “You've made me talk till my throat is dry. Give me time to moisten it.” Chen set down the cup and rose. “I'll go ahead and arrange matters concerning your difficulties. Come to Jucheng yourself at noon. Will that do?” “You mean you'll first find money for me? There's no need to worry about that now.” “No ceremony! Ceremony will only make you suffer. Frankly, your circumstances aren't good. You might find even a dinner party difficult to afford. If you have to attend to business while scraping money together for creditors, your situation will be exposed and your dignity lost. Better to let me arrange it beforehand.” Liu saw the sense of this and left it to him, promising to meet Hu at Jucheng at noon.

zh: 到时候，陈世龙已在门口等候，迎入客座，胡雪岩兜头一揖，口称“三叔”，同时看到一桌银台面的盛宴，四干四湿的果碟子都已经摆好了。刘不才称他“雪岩兄”，不提亲戚，只道仰慕，郁四陪客，再加陈世龙从中穿针引线，将刘不才当上宾看待，捧得他飘飘然，大为过瘾。茶罢入席，自然是刘不才首座，左右是郁、陈二席，胡雪岩坐了主位。酒过三巡，话入正题，是郁四提起来的。“刘三哥”郁四说，“老胡想开药店，原来我不赞成，现在我想想也不错。行善济世，总是好事，将来我也要加入股子。不过，老胡跟我都是外行，一切要我仰仗。”“不敢，不敢！”刘不才说，“这是我的本行，凡有可以效劳之处，在所不辞。不过，我还不晓得怎么样一个开法，规模如何？”“这就要请教三叔了。规模嘛，”胡雪岩想了想说，“初步我想凑十万两银子的本钱。”十万两银子的本钱，还是“初步”！如果不是有陈世龙的先人之言，以及素有宫名的郁四表示要入股，刘不才还真有点不敢相信。“这个规模，”他兴奋之中又有顾虑，“就很大了。不过乱世当口，只怕生意不见得如太平年岁！”
en: At the appointed hour, Chen was waiting at the entrance. He led Liu into the reception room, where Hu greeted him with a deep bow and called him “Third Uncle.” A sumptuous banquet with silver tableware was ready, including four dishes of dried fruit and four of fresh. Liu addressed him as “Brother Xueyan,” speaking only of his admiration and avoiding the family connection. Yu kept them company, while Chen helped the conversation along. Treated as the guest of honour, Liu felt wonderfully flattered. After tea they took their places, Liu at the head, Yu and Chen on either side, and Hu in the host's seat. Following three rounds of wine, Yu introduced the business. “Brother Liu, I didn't originally approve of Old Hu's plan for a medicine shop. Now I think it makes sense. Doing good and helping people is always worthwhile. I mean to invest too. But he and I know nothing of the trade. We must rely on you for everything.” “You flatter me. This is my own trade, and I'll gladly do whatever I can. But I don't yet know the plan or its scale.” “That's where we need your advice, Third Uncle. As for scale...” Hu considered. “To begin with, I mean to raise a hundred thousand taels.” A hundred thousand, merely to begin! Without Chen's advance account and Yu's promise to invest, backed by his reputation for wealth, Liu would hardly have believed it. Excited but cautious, he said, “That would be a very large concern. But in troubled times, trade may not be as good as in peaceful years.”

zh: “太平年岁吃膏滋药的多，乱世当口，我们要卖救命的药，少卖补药。”胡雪岩说：“三叔，生意你不要担心。大兵以后，定有大疫，逃难的人，早饥夜寒，水土不服，生了病一定要买药，买不起的我们送。”“嗯，嗯！”刘不才心想；此人的口气，倒真是不小。口气虽大，用心却深，“三叔，”胡雪岩笑道，“我想做生意的道理都是一样的，创牌子最要紧，我说送药，就是为了创牌子的。”“这我也晓得。”刘不才平静地答道，“凡是药店，都有这个规矩，贫病奉送。不过，没有啥用处，做好事而已。”“那是送得不得法！我在上海听人讲过一个故事，蛮有意思，讲给大家听听。”
en: “In peaceful times, people take nourishing medicinal pastes. In troubled times, we should sell medicines that save lives and fewer tonics,” Hu replied. “Don't worry about trade, Third Uncle. Great wars are followed by great epidemics. Refugees suffer hunger in the morning, cold at night, and difficulty adapting to unfamiliar conditions. When they fall ill, they must buy medicine. Those who can't afford it shall receive it free.” Liu nodded, thinking that the man certainly spoke on a grand scale. Yet there was calculation behind the grand words. “The principles of business are the same everywhere,” Hu continued with a smile. “Establishing a name comes first. That's why I propose giving medicine away.” “I understand that,” Liu answered calmly. “Every medicine shop gives to the poor and sick. It doesn't do much beyond being a good deed.” “Then they're doing it the wrong way. I heard an interesting story in Shanghai. Let me tell you.”

zh: 胡雪岩讲的这个故事，出在雍正年间，京城里有家小药店，承揽供应宫里“御药店”的药，选料特别地道，雍正皇帝很相信他家的药。有一年逢辰戌丑未大比之年，会试是在三月里，称为春闱。头一年冬天不冷，雪下得不多，一开春天气反常，春瘟流行，举人病倒的很多，能够支持的，也多是胃口不开，委靡不振。这家药店的主人，配了一种药，专治时气，托内务府大臣面奏皇帝，说是愿意奉送每一个举子，带入闱中，以备不时之需。科场里的号舍，站起来立不直身子，靠下来伸不直双腿，三场下来，体格不好的就支持不住，何况精神不爽？雍正是个最能体察人情的皇帝，本来就有些在替举子担忧，一听这话，大为嘉许。于是这家药店奉旨送药，派人守在贡院门口，等举子入闱，用不着他们开口，在考篮里放一包药。包封纸印得极其考究，上面还有“奉旨”字样，另外附一张仿单，把他家有名的丸散豪丹，都刻印在上面。结果，一半是他家的药好，一半是他家的运气好，人闱举子，报“病号”出场的，并不比前几科会试来得多，足见药的功效。这一来，出闱的举子，不管中不中，都先要买他家的药，生意兴隆得不得了。
en: The story concerned a small medicine shop in the capital during Yongzheng's reign. It supplied medicines to the palace dispensary, choosing particularly genuine, high-quality ingredients, and the emperor trusted its products. In one of the Dragon, Dog, Ox, or Goat years when the great examination was held, the metropolitan examination fell in the third month and was known as the Spring Examination. The preceding winter had been mild, with little snow. Abnormal weather in early spring brought an epidemic, and many provincial examination graduates fell ill. Even those who could carry on often had no appetite and felt listless. The shop's owner prepared a remedy for the seasonal illness and asked a minister of the Imperial Household Department to inform the emperor that he wished to give it to every candidate to carry into the examination compound for use if needed. The cells there were so small that a man could neither stand fully upright nor stretch out his legs when reclining. After three sessions, a weak constitution might give way even in good health, let alone when unwell. Yongzheng, an emperor keenly attentive to people's circumstances, had already been worrying about the candidates. He warmly approved. Acting by imperial command, the shop stationed men at the entrance to the examination compound. As the candidates entered, a packet of medicine was placed in each examination basket without anyone needing to ask. The wrappers were elegantly printed and bore the words “By Imperial Command.” Each packet also contained a leaflet listing the shop's celebrated pills, powders, ointments, and elixirs. The outcome owed something to the quality of the medicines and something to the shop's good fortune: no more candidates withdrew through illness than in previous examinations. This was taken as evidence of the remedy's effectiveness. Afterwards, whether they had passed or failed, the candidates all went to buy the shop's medicines, and business flourished extraordinarily.

zh: “你想想看，”胡雪岩说，“天下十八省，远到云南、贵州等。都晓得他家的药。你花多少银子，雇人替你遍天下去贴招贴，都没有这佯的效验。这就是脑筋会不会动的关系。““真是，”郁四笑道，“老胡，你做生意就是这点上厉害！别人想不到的花样，你想得到。”“那么，”刘不才的态度也不同了，很起劲的问：“我们怎么送法？”“我们要送军营里……”“那再好都没有。”刘不才抢着说道，“我有‘诸葛行军散’的方子，配料与众不同，其效如神。”“真的再好都没有！”胡雪岩说，“送军营里要送得多，这当然也有个送法。将来我来动脑筋，叫人出钱，我们只收成本。捐助军营，或者有捐饷的，指明捐我们的诸葛行军散多少，什么药多少？折算多少银子。只要药好，军营里的弟兄们相信，那我就有第二步办法，要赚钱了！”他故意不说，要试试刘不才的才具，看他猜不猜得到这第二步办法是什么？刘不才猜不到，陈世龙却开了口，“我懂！”他说，“胡先生的意思，是不是想跟‘粮台’打交道？”这就无怪乎刘不才猜不到了，军营里的规制，他根本不懂。胡雪岩对陈世龙深深点头、颇有“孺子可教”的欣慰之色，然后接着他的话作进一步的解释。
en: “Think of it,” Hu said. “People in all eighteen provinces, even distant Yunnan and Guizhou, came to know their medicines. However much you spent hiring men to put up notices throughout the empire, you couldn't achieve that effect. It all depends on whether you use your head.” “Exactly!” Yu laughed. “That's what makes you so formidable in business. You think of things nobody else can.” Liu's attitude had changed too. Eagerly, he asked, “Then how shall we give ours away?” “To the military camps...” “Nothing could be better!” Liu interrupted. “I have a formula for Zhuge Marching Powder. Its ingredients are quite exceptional, and its effects are miraculous.” “Excellent indeed! We'll need to give large quantities to the camps, and naturally there's a method. I'll devise ways to have others provide the money, while we charge only cost. People contributing to the army, including those donating military funds, can specify quantities of our Zhuge Marching Powder and other medicines, with their value calculated in silver. As long as the medicines are good and the soldiers trust them, I have a second step that will bring a profit.” Hu deliberately withheld the next step to test Liu's ability to guess. Liu could not, but Chen spoke. “I understand! Do you mean to deal with the military supply offices?” Naturally Liu had failed to guess: he knew nothing of army arrangements. Hu nodded earnestly at Chen, looking pleased with such a promising pupil, then developed his explanation.

zh: “粮台除掉上前线打仗以外，几乎什么事都要管，最麻烦的当然是一仗下来，料理伤亡。所以粮台上用的药极多。我们跟粮台打交道，就是要卖药给他。价钱要便宜，东西要好，还可以欠帐，让他公事上好交代，私底下，我们回扣当然照送……““这笔生意不得了！”刘不才失声而呼，他有个毛病喜欢抢话说，“不过，这笔本钱也不得了。”“是啊！”胡雪岩又说，“话也要讲回来，既然可以让他欠帐，也就可以预支，只看他粮台上有钱没钱？现在‘江南大营’靠各省协饷，湖南湘乡的曾侍郎，带勇出省也要靠各地的协饷。只要有路子，我们的药价，在协饷上坐扣，也不是办不到的事。只看各人的做法！”“只看各人的脑筋，雪岩兄，”刘不才高举酒盅：“我奉敬一杯！”“不敢当。还要仰仗三叔。”“一句话！”刘不才指着陈世龙，“他晓得我的脾气，我也跟他说过了，我就赌这一记了！”
en: “A military supply office attends to almost everything except fighting at the front. The most troublesome business is naturally dealing with casualties after a battle, so it uses enormous quantities of medicine. That's what we would sell it. Prices must be low and goods good. We can extend credit, making the public accounts easier to manage. Privately, of course, we'll pay the usual kickbacks...” “What a business!” Liu exclaimed. Interrupting was a habit of his. “But what an amount of capital it would require!” “Yes. Though the reverse also holds: if we can allow credit, we can request payment in advance. It depends on whether the supply office has money. The Jiangnan Grand Camp relies on military subsidies from the provinces. Vice Minister Zeng of Xiangxiang in Hunan also relies on contributions from various places to support his volunteer troops beyond his own province. With the right connections, payment for our medicines might be deducted directly from those subsidies. It depends on how one goes about it.” “On how one uses one's head!” Liu raised his cup. “Brother Xueyan, I drink to you.” “You do me too much honour. We shall still rely on you, Third Uncle.” “There's only one thing to say!” Liu pointed at Chen. “He knows my temperament. I've told him already: I'll stake everything on this one wager!”

zh: 说着，他从贴肉白袋里，摸出一个红绫封面、青绫包角、丝线装订、装潢极其讲究的小本子递了过来，胡雪岩看着那上面的题签是：“杏林秘笈”四个字，就知道是什么内容。“这就是我的‘赌本’。说扑上去就扑上去。”他又看着陈世龙说问：“你说我做得对不对！”在陈世龙看，不但觉得他做得对，而且觉得他做得够味，这样子，自己替胡雪岩探路的，也有面子，所以笑容满面，不断颔首。“你请收起来。三叔既然赞成我的主意，那就好办了。回头我们好好的商量一番。”两个人都很漂亮，一个“献宝”示诚，一个不肯苟且接受。推来推去，半天，是陈世龙想出来的一个办法，取张包银圆的桑皮纸，把“杏林秘笈”包好封固，在封口上画了个花押，交给郁四保管，郁四当即把它锁了在保险箱里。
en: From a white pouch worn against his skin, Liu produced a small, beautifully made book, bound with silk thread, its cover of red silk and its corners protected with blue. He handed it over. Seeing the title, Secrets of the Apricot Grove, Hu knew what it contained. “Here's my stake. When I say I'll stake it, I do.” Liu looked again at Chen. “Tell me, am I doing the right thing?” Chen thought not only that it was right, but that Liu had acted splendidly. As Hu's advance negotiator, he shared the credit. Smiling broadly, he nodded repeatedly. “Please put it away,” Hu said. “Since you approve of my proposal, matters are easy. We'll discuss them carefully afterwards.” Both men behaved generously: one offered his treasure to prove his sincerity, while the other would not casually accept it. They pressed and declined for some time until Chen proposed a solution. He fetched a sheet of mulberry-bark paper used for wrapping silver dollars, wrapped the book, sealed it, and marked the closure with a personal sign. It was entrusted to Yu, who immediately locked it in the safe.

zh: 饭罢品茗，那就都是刘不才的话了，谈一爿药店，如何开法，怎么样用人，怎么样进货。怎么样炮制，利弊如何，要当心的是什么？讲的人，兴高采烈，听的人，全神贯注，彼此都很认真。“三叔！”胡雪岩听完了说，“这里面的规矩诀窍，我一时也还不大懂，将来都要靠你。不过我有这么个想法，‘说真方，卖假药’最要不得，我们要叫主顾看得明明白白，人家才会相信。”“那也可以。譬如说，我们要合‘十全大补丸，了，不妨预先贴出招贴去，请大家来看，是不是货真价实？”“就是这一点难！我不晓得你用的药，究竟是真是假？”刘不才一愣，“照你这样子说，譬如卖鹿茸，还要养只鹿在店里？”他的语气显得相当困惑！哪知胡雪岩毫不迟疑地回答，“对！这有何不可？”这对刘不才是一大启发，拓宽了他的视界，仔细想了想，有了很多主意，“既然如此，那就敞开手来干。”他说，“只要舍得花钱，不怕没有新鲜花样。”“我们也不是故意耍花样，只不过生意要做得既诚实，又热闹！”“ ‘既诚实，又热闹，！”刘不才复念了一遍，深深记在心里。
en: After dinner, over tea, Liu did all the talking. He explained how to open a medicine shop, hire staff, obtain supplies, and prepare the medicines; what advantages and difficulties to expect; and what required caution. He spoke enthusiastically while the others listened intently. Everyone took the matter seriously. “Third Uncle,” Hu said when he finished, “I can't grasp all these rules and practices at once. We shall depend on you. But I have one thought. Nothing could be worse than quoting genuine formulas and selling false medicines. Customers must see plainly for themselves before they'll trust us.” “That can be arranged. If we're preparing Shiquan Dabu Pills, for example, we could announce it beforehand and invite people to see whether the ingredients are genuine and worth the price.” “That's precisely the difficulty. How do I know whether what you're using is genuine?” Liu paused. “By that reasoning, if we sell deer velvet, must we keep a deer in the shop?” He sounded thoroughly puzzled. Hu answered without hesitation. “Yes! Why not?” This opened Liu's eyes. After consideration, many ideas occurred to him. “Then let's give ourselves a free hand. If we're willing to spend, there'll be no shortage of fresh ideas.” “We aren't devising tricks merely for their own sake. We want business to be both honest and lively.” “Honest and lively!” Liu repeated, committing the words firmly to memory.

zh: 谈到这样，就该有进一步的表示了，陈世龙看看已是时候。向刘不才使了个眼色。胡雪岩自然也看到了，不等他有何表示，先就站了起来。“三叔，你坐一坐。我跟郁四哥有些事谈。”其实无事，只不过在里问陪郁四躺烟榻，避开了好让阵世龙说话。“刘三爷，你看！”陈世龙递了个折子过去。折子是个存折，聚成钱庄所出，但打开来一看，并无存数记载，看起来是个不管用的空折子。“为啥不记载钱数呢？”陈世龙问道，“三叔，你懂不懂其中的意思？”“说实话，我不懂！”刘不才说，“雪岩的花样真多，我服了他了，你说，是怎么回事？”“是尽你用，你要取多少就多少，所以不必记载钱数。不过，一天最多只能取一次。”有这样的好事！刘不才闻所未闻，但当然不会疑心胡雪岩是开什么玩笑。细想一想，问出一句话来作为试探。“这样漫无限制，倒是真相信我！倘若我要取个一万八千呢？”“那要看你作何用处？只要你有信用，一万八千也不是取不到的。”
en: At this point, some further gesture was needed. Judging the moment right, Chen gave Liu a meaningful glance. Hu noticed too and rose before Liu could respond. “Stay a little, Third Uncle. Brother Yu and I have something to discuss.” In fact, there was nothing. He merely went inside to lie on the opium couch with Yu, leaving Chen free to speak. “Third Master Liu, look at this.” Chen handed him a booklet. It was a passbook issued by Jucheng, but when Liu opened it, there was no balance entered. It looked like a useless blank book. “Why is there no amount written in it?” Chen asked. “Third Uncle, do you understand the meaning?” “Honestly, no. Xueyan has so many ingenious devices that I'm convinced of his ability. Tell me what this means.” “It's for whatever you need. You can withdraw as much as you require, so there's no need to enter an amount. Only, you may withdraw no more than once a day.” Liu had never heard of anything so fortunate. Naturally, he did not suspect Hu of joking. After considering, he tested the offer. “Such unlimited freedom shows real trust. Suppose I wanted, say, eighteen thousand taels?” “That depends on the purpose. With sufficient credit, even eighteen thousand would not be impossible.”

zh: 这一说，刘不才懂了其中的深意。胡雪岩当然关照过，有个限度，超出限度，聚成的伙计就会托词拒绝。至于说一天只能取一次，那是防备自己拿了钱上赌场，如果只是正用，即使不够，也可以留到明天再说。唯有下赌注，是不能欠帐的。转念到此，刘不才又发了“大爷脾气”，把折子交了回去，“谢谢！”他的声音有点冷，“我怕我自己管不住自己，有了这么一条源源不绝的财路，一定输得认不得家！”“刘三爷！”陈世龙的态度很平静，“你说过决心赌这一记！这话算不算数？”“自然算数！那几张方子，就是我的赌本，已经全部交出去了，还有啥话说？”“那不是赌本。胡先生说，你果然有此决心，只要你做一件事，才算是你真的下了赌本，真的愿意赌一记。这件事说难不难，说容易不容易。我要等你想停当了，我再说。”
en: Now Liu understood the deeper meaning. Naturally, Hu had given instructions and set a limit. Beyond it, Jucheng's clerks would find a reason to refuse. The daily restriction guarded against his taking the money to a gambling house. For a proper purpose, any shortfall could wait until tomorrow. Bets alone could not be placed on credit. This thought revived his haughty temper. He handed the book back. “Thank you.” His voice was cold. “I'm afraid I can't control myself. With an inexhaustible source of money, I'd certainly gamble until I no longer knew my way home.” Chen remained calm. “Third Master Liu, you said you'd stake everything on this one wager. Did you mean it?” “Naturally! Those formulas are my stake, and I've handed over every one. What more is there to say?” “That isn't the stake. Mr Hu says that, if you're truly determined, there's one thing you must do to show that you have really committed yourself. It isn't altogether difficult, nor altogether easy. I'll wait until you've thought it through before telling you.”

zh: 刘不才想了想问：“是我做得到的事？”“当然！”“好，你说。”“刘三爷！”陈世龙的神态异常郑重，“外头跑跑的，说话算话！”“那还用说。小和尚，”刘不才不悦，“你真是门缝里看人！”陈世龙是受了胡雪岩的教，听了芙蓉细谈过她三叔，有意要逼刘不才发愤，因而若无其事地答道：“不是我门缝里看人，把你刘三爷看扁了，只因为我也跟刘三爷差不多，知道这件事不大容易办得到，而且说出来伤感情，所以不能不问个清楚。唉！”他有意做作：“想想还是不说的好！”刘不才气得直咬牙，但不便发作。忍了又忍，才说了这样一句：“说不说随便你！我倒不相信我刘某人会叫你小和尚把我看轻了！”“这也难说。我说句话，你刘三爷就不见得做得到。”“好，你说！”刘不才用拳将桌子一捣，站起身来，双手撑桌，上身前俯，以泰山压顶之势，仿佛要把陈肚龙一下子打倒在地上似的。
en: Liu considered. “Is it something I can do?” “Of course.” “Very well. Tell me.” Chen became unusually solemn. “A man who goes about in the world must keep his word.” “Need you say that? Little Monk, you look at people through a crack in the door!” Liu was offended. Hu had instructed Chen, and Furong had described her uncle fully. Deliberately seeking to rouse Liu's resolve, Chen answered casually, “I'm not looking through a crack to make you seem small. I'm much like you myself and know this won't be easy. Besides, mentioning it might hurt our friendship. That's why I have to be certain.” He gave a calculated sigh. “Perhaps I'd better not say it.” Liu ground his teeth but could hardly lose his temper. After restraining himself repeatedly, he managed, “Say it or don't, as you please! I refuse to believe that I, Liu, will give you reason to despise me.” “That's hard to say. There's one thing you may not be able to do.” “Tell me!” Liu struck the table with his fist and rose, bracing both hands on it and leaning forward, looming like a mountain about to crush Chen to the floor.

zh: “那么我说，你能不能象我一样，从此不进赌场？”听得这一声，刘不才的身子不自觉地往下坐，依然坐了下来，半晌作声不得。“胡先生说过了，你要有这个决心。才显得是真心。他又说他不希望你别样，‘吃着嫖赌’四个字，只希望你少一个！”陈世龙说，“照我看，如果这一个字都不能少，那……”他摇摇头。“不必再说，说下去就难听了！”他不说，刘不才也想象得到，吃着嫖赌，四字俱全，非搞得讨饭不可！“胡先生又说，赌钱是赌心思，做生意也是赌心思，何不把赌钱的心思，花到做生意上头来？只要你生意做得入门了，自然会有趣味。那时就不想赌钱了！”刘不才沉吟不语，但神态慢慢在变，飞扬浮躁，带些怒气的脸色，渐渐消失，代之而起的是平静、沉着，最后终于点头。“话不错！”他清晰地吐出来五个字：“我要戒赌了！”“恭喜，恭喜！”陈世龙笑容满面地拱手，同时仍旧把那个存折推了过来。
en: “Then can you do as I've done and never enter a gambling house again?” At the question, Liu's body sank involuntarily back into his chair. For a long time he could not speak. “Mr Hu says that only such a resolution will prove your sincerity. He asks nothing else. Of fine food, clothes, brothels, and gambling, he only wants you to give up one. In my view, if you can't abandon even that...” Chen shook his head. “There's no need to say more. It would sound unpleasant.” Even without the words, Liu could imagine them. Indulging all four would certainly reduce him to beggary. “Mr Hu also says that gambling is a contest of minds, and business is a contest of minds too. Why not put your gambler's ingenuity into business? Once you learn its ways, you'll naturally find it interesting. Then you won't want to gamble.” Liu considered in silence. Gradually his expression changed. The flightiness, impatience, and anger faded, giving way to calm and steadiness. At last he nodded. “That's sound advice.” His words were clear. “I'm giving up gambling!” “Congratulations!” Chen smiled and clasped his hands, pushing the passbook towards him again.

zh: “那么，我们谈正事。讲了半天，到底要我如何着手？我要弄个明白。”这自然又只有请胡雪岩来谈。事情到了这地步，已经无须借聚成的地方，自然而然地，胡雪岩一邀就把他邀到了家，跟芙蓉叔侄之间的芥蒂，当然也就不知不觉地消除了。一夕之谈，谈出了头绪。胡雪岩的药店，定名“胡庆余堂”，请刘不才负责筹备，约定三天以后，跟他同船回杭州，细节到了杭州再谈。“三叔！”芙蓉劝他，“你也真该收收心了。有适当的人家，娶位三婶娘回来。”“现在还谈不到此。”刘不才只是摇头，“我现在的心思，完全在胡庆余堂上头。雪岩，”他马上把话题扯了开去，“我想，房子要画图样自己盖。”“我也是这么样想。一切从头做起！”“对，从头做起！”刘不才说，“我自己也是这样。”
en: “Then let's discuss business. After all this talk, how should I begin? I want to understand.” That naturally required Hu. With matters settled, there was no further need to borrow Jucheng's premises. Hu easily persuaded Liu to come home with him, and the estrangement between uncle and niece dissolved almost without their noticing. An evening's discussion brought the undertaking into shape. The shop would be called Hu Qingyu Hall, and Liu would take charge of preparations. They agreed that he would accompany Hu to Hangzhou in three days. Details could be discussed there. “Third Uncle,” Furong urged, “you really ought to settle down. If there's a suitable woman, marry her and give me a new aunt.” “It's too early for that.” Liu shook his head. “My whole mind is on Hu Qingyu Hall.” He immediately changed the subject. “Xueyan, I think we should draw up plans and build our own premises.” “I think so too. Start everything from the beginning!” “Exactly,” Liu replied. “That's what I'm doing myself.”

zh: 果然，刘不才是重新做人，就在这三天工夫当中，他开了个“节略”，把胡庆余堂从购地建屋到用人进货，如何布置，如何管理，都详详细细地写了下来。胡雪岩做生意，还是第一次有这样周到的盘算。然而他做生意也是第一次这佯不着实。如今说大话的不是刘不才，是胡雪岩，“初步我想凑十万两银子的本钱”，这话是说出去了，银子却还不知道在什么地方？郁四虽说过愿意加股的话，但他已倾全力支持，胡雪岩总不好意思要他卖田卖地来帮自己的忙，而况这个年头，兵荒马乱，不动产根本就变不成现钱。好的是还不需要马上拿钱出来。胡雪岩的打算是，到了杭州跟王有龄商量，开药店是极稳妥的生意，又有活人济世的好名目，说不定黄宗汉的极饱的宦囊中，肯拿出一部分来，用他家人的名义投作股本。如果有黄抚台提倡，另外再找有钱的官儿来凑数，事情就容易成功了。这当然是初步打算，只求把事业办成，谈不到赚钱，更谈不到照自己的理想去做。当然，刘不才绝不会想到他肚子里是这么一把算盘，依旧兴高采烈，见了面就谈药店，这样一路谈到杭州，胡雪岩把他安置在钱庄里，派了一个小伙计，每天陪他到各处去逛，招待得非有周到。
en: He truly began afresh. During those three days, he produced a detailed plan for Hu Qingyu Hall, covering the purchase of land, construction, staffing, supplies, layout, and management. Hu had never before planned a business so thoroughly. Yet never before had he undertaken one on so uncertain a basis. This time the boastful man was Hu, not Liu. He had spoken of raising an initial hundred thousand taels, but did not know where the money would come from. Yu had offered to invest, yet was already supporting him to the limit of his resources. Hu could hardly ask him to sell his land, and in these unsettled times property could scarcely be turned into cash anyway. Fortunately, no immediate payment was required. Hu intended to consult Wang Youling in Hangzhou. A medicine shop was a sound business, with the admirable purpose of saving lives and helping people. Perhaps Huang Zonghan would contribute part of his well-filled official purse, investing under a member of his family's name. With Governor Huang taking the lead, finding other wealthy officials to provide the rest would be easier. This was only an initial plan, aimed at getting the enterprise established. There could be no talk yet of profits, much less of conducting it entirely according to Hu's ideals. Liu never imagined these calculations. Still enthusiastic, he talked of the shop whenever they met, all the way to Hangzhou. There Hu lodged him at the bank and assigned a young clerk to accompany him on daily outings, treating him with the greatest consideration.
